novel_features.name: Public-path auth omission
novel_features.description: HTTP client skips Authorization header on documented public path prefixes (/classified_locations/*). The CLI works for users without a token AND for users whose 6h OAuth token has expired or become invalid.
novel_features.rationale: Discovered during release v0.1.0 smoke test: ML rejects expired tokens with HTTP 401 even on endpoints that don't require auth. README documented countries as public but the CLI made it unreachable for any user with a stale token. Fixed by isPublicPath() check in internal/client/client.go.

novel_features.name: watch (stub)
novel_features.description: Poll a saved catalog search at interval; emit JSON line on new product appearance (diff vs prior run). Cron-friendly resale-opportunity radar.
novel_features.rationale: ML API has no native webhook for new products in a category. Client-side poll-and-diff is the only path. Hidden experimental stub in v0.1.x; per-command logic ships in v0.2.x.

novel_features.name: compare (stub)
novel_features.description: Token-bag fingerprint dedup of catalog search results. Collapses near-duplicate listings to one exemplar per fingerprint.
novel_features.rationale: ML catalog search returns variant collisions (same product in 3 colors as 3 entries). Client-side dedup helps analytics workflows. Hidden experimental stub in v0.1.x.

novel_features.name: ml-analytics (stub)
novel_features.description: Local SQLite analytics over synced catalog: price percentiles, IQR outlier trim, top sellers by category, std-dev distribution.
novel_features.rationale: ML API does not expose category-level price aggregations. Client-side stats over synced data fills the gap for pricing-intelligence workflows. Hidden experimental stub in v0.1.x.
